guitar.notes: Chuck Berry was a guitarist himself, famously associated with the Gibson ES-350T (and later ES-355) — foundational rock'n'roll guitar imagery.

tone.target: bright twangy rock-and-roll lead with slight tube breakup
tone.profile: bright twangy rock-and-roll lead with slight tube breakup
tone.summary: A classic Fender-style chain using a light boost for attack, followed by an AC30 or US Deluxe amp model, paired with a bright 2x12 cab, finished with slapback delay and room reverb.

rig.name: Chuck Berry - Johnny B. Goode - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain signal clarity.
Enhance the initial attack and 'twang' characteristic of single-coil guitars.
blocks.gap: A dedicated bright boost is ideal, but Boost serves this function well for adding punch.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and focused on natural tube breakup rather than heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The target requires minimal gain structure; keeping this module bypassed is key to achieving 'slight tube breakup'.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the sound of a small Fender combo amplifier (small Fender combo clue), providing bright, clean headroom with natural breakup.

alternatives.model: AC30 TB (if more British chime is desired)

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, articulate cabinet sound suitable for twangy rock and roll.

alternatives.model: UK Vintage 4x12 (if more punch is needed)

blocks.purpose: Counteract any potential mid-scooping and enhance the bright, twangy high end.
No wah needed; the focus is on pure twang and attack.
blocks.gap: The tone requires directness, making a bypass ideal.

blocks.purpose: Avoid deep modulation as per the 'avoid' list; keep this module bypassed.
Implement the required slapback echo effect.

alternatives.model: Digital Delay (if more complex repeats are needed)

blocks.purpose: Add subtle room ambience without sounding overly wet or deep.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a more defined, metallic reverb is desired)

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for increased cabinet realism, matching the small Fender combo aesthetic.

proposals.reason: Enhance vintage Fender cab character and articulation.
